title: Installment Fee Size Bands — LandlordGuard Fee Tariff
content:
**Size bands.** On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy the fee basis of an installment fee depends on the amount of the installment the fee is charged on, which is the most recently billed installment: an installment above 1000 USD takes 0.8 percent of the installment amount; an installment of 250 USD or less takes half the tier's installment service charge; any other installment takes the tier's installment service charge.

The fee basis is the starting amount of the installment fee, to which the fee adjustment is then added.

| Amount of the most recently billed installment | Fee basis |
|---|---|
| above 1000 USD | 0.8 percent of the installment amount |
| above 250 USD and up to 1000 USD | the tier's installment service charge |
| 250 USD or less | half the tier's installment service charge |

## The tier's charge and its half (USD)

| Tier | Installment service charge | Half |
|---|---|---|
| DP-1 Basic | 6.00 | 3.00 |
| DP-2 Broad | 6.00 | 3.00 |
| DP-3 Special | 5.00 | 2.50 |
| DP-3 Special Plus | 5.00 | 2.50 |
| DP-3 Premier | 4.00 | 2.00 |
| DP-3 Portfolio | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Both sides of each band (hypothetical installments on a tier charging 5.00 USD)

| Installment amount | Fee basis |
|---|---|
| 1,500.00 | 0.8 percent of 1,500.00, that is 12.00 |
| 1,000.00 | 5.00 (not above 1000) |
| 1,000.50 | 0.8 percent of 1,000.50, that is 8.004, rounded only in the final fee |
| 250.01 | 5.00 |
| 250.00 | 2.50 |
